attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.0.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, 10.0.20.0/24). Firewall policy permits only node2->node3 TCP/5432 and refuses every other cross-network connection in both directions. Verified via falsification testing (baseline default-deny, allow-rule effect, a forwarding-pairing misconfiguration that over-permitted traffic was caught via testing and corrected). Completed mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
